**Coaching note (80 words):**
When your opponent leaves a piece undefended, look for forcing moves—especially checks—that exploit it. Here, Bxd4+ is a check that forces White to recapture (cxd4), but this leaves the queen on g6 completely unguarded to your rook. After Rxg6, you've won a full queen. The lesson: checks that also threaten or expose enemy pieces are powerful. Always scan for forcing moves that win material by removing defenders or creating unavoidable threats.
